title: ASTRA LiveOps - Runtime and PostgreSQL
description: OTLP signals collected through the EDOT gateway. Counts are intentionally low-cardinality operational signals.

data_source.query: FROM traces-generic.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend | STATS spans = COUNT() BY bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend) | SORT bucket

FROM metrics-generic.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND `resource.attributes.service.name` LIKE "Astra*" | STATS samples = COUNT() BY bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend) | SORT bucket

FROM metrics-generic.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND (attributes.synthetic IS NULL OR attributes.synthetic == false) | EVAL failure_count = TO_LONG(`metrics.astra.postgres.connection.acquire.failures`) | WHERE failure_count > 0 | STATS failures = SUM(failure_count) BY bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend) | SORT bucket

FROM metrics-generic.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND (attributes.synthetic IS NULL OR attributes.synthetic == false) | EVAL attempts = COALESCE(TO_LONG(`metrics.astra.postgres.connection.acquire.attempts`), 0), failures = COALESCE(TO_LONG(`metrics.astra.postgres.connection.acquire.failures`), 0) | STATS attempts = SUM(attempts), failures = SUM(failures) BY bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend) | WHERE attempts > 0 | EVAL burn_rate = TO_DOUBLE(failures) / TO_DOUBLE(attempts) / 0.001 | SORT bucket

FROM metrics-generic.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend | EVAL published = TO_LONG(`metrics.astra.outbox.published`) | WHERE published IS NOT NULL | STATS published = SUM(published) BY bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend) | SORT bucket

FROM metrics-generic.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend | EVAL retries = TO_LONG(`metrics.astra.outbox.retry_scheduled`) | WHERE retries IS NOT NULL | STATS retries = SUM(retries) BY bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend) | SORT bucket

FROM metrics-generic.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend | EVAL dead_letters = TO_LONG(`metrics.astra.outbox.dead_lettered`) | WHERE dead_letters IS NOT NULL | STATS dead_letters = SUM(dead_letters) BY bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend) | SORT bucket
